description: This source file defines a set of tests for encoding Swift data structures (array and dictionary values, primitive arrays) into JSON, using the `AnyCodable` type from the `OpenClawProtocol` module. It verifies proper encoding and decoding with test assertions.

methods.name: encodes swift array and dictionary values
methods.description: Tests encoding of Swift array and dictionary values into JSON using `AnyCodable` and verifies the resulting JSON structure and content.

methods.name: protocol any codable encodes primitive arrays
methods.description: Tests encoding of primitive arrays containing mixed types, including integers, strings, `NSNull`, and dictionaries, into JSON with `AnyCodable`.
